name: Marriage After Divorce
overview: Scripture reveals that God views marriage as a sacred covenant, and divorce is permitted only under specific circumstances, such as marital unfaithfulness. Deuteronomy 24:1 outlines the practice of issuing a certificate of divorce when a man finds 'some uncleanness' in his wife, while Malachi 2:16 emphasizes that the LORD hates divorce because it covers violence with deceit. Jesus further clarifies in Matthew 5:32 and 19:9 that remarriage after divorce, except for the cause of fornication, constitutes adultery, a point reinforced in Mark 10:12. These passages collectively affirm the seriousness of marriage and the limited grounds for divorce and remarriage within a Christ-centered biblical framework.
